players.bio: Aaron Paul Morley is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One side Wycombe Wanderers.
Anders Hagelskjær (born 16 February 1997) is a Danish professional footballer who plays for EFL League One Club Wycombe Wanderers.

Caolan Stephen Boyd-Munce (born 26 January 2000) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Wycombe Wanderers. Boyd-Munce made one senior appearance for Glentoran in the NIFL Premiership before moving to England in 2016 to join EFL Championship club Birmingham City.

Cauley Woodrow is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Wycombe Wanderers F.C. in EFL League One. Woodrow began his professional career at Luton Town, in the Conference Premier at the time, for whom he made three appearances in the FA Trophy as a 16-year-old.

Connor Taylor is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Taylor spent his youth at Port Vale's academy and Stafford Rangers, before signing a one-year scholarship with Stoke City in September 2019. He went on to spend brief spells on loan at non-League clubs Ashton United and Chester.
Conor William Hazard (born 5 March 1998) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers and the Northern Ireland national team.
Dan Casey (born 29 October 1997) is an Irish association football player who plays as a defender for Wycombe Wanderers.

Daniel William Harvie (born 14 July 1998) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a wing-back for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Harvie made his first-team debut for Aberdeen as an injury-time substitute in a Scottish Premiership match against Partick Thistle in March 2016. Harvie joined Scottish Championship club Dumbarton on loan in August 2016.

Daniel William John Ings is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Ings started his career in the youth team of Southampton but was released as a schoolboy. He subsequently joined AFC Bournemouth, progressing through their youth system, while also spending time at Dorchester Town on loan.

Emre James Vann Tezgel is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for League One club Wycombe Wanderers on loan from EFL Championship club Stoke City. He is Stoke City's youngest ever senior player, having debuted at 16 in January 2022. He has represented England internationally at U16 and U17 levels.

Ewan Henderson (born 27 March 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Henderson has previously played for Celtic, Ross County, Dunfermline Athletic, Hibernian, Oostende and Beerschot.
Wilfred Oluwafemi Onyedinma (born 24 November 1996) is a Nigerian professional footballer who currently plays for EFL League One side Wycombe Wanderers in his fourth spell with the club.

Jack Grimmer (born 25 January 1994) is a Scottish professional footballer who most currently plays as a defender for League One club Wycombe Wanderers. A Scotland under-21 international, he began his career at Aberdeen, becoming the club's youngest ever player at the age of 16.
Jamie Anthony Mullins (born 29 September 2004) is an Irish footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One Side Wycombe Wanderers.

Joe Wildsmith is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Wildsmith signed a two-and-a-half year professional contract with Sheffield Wednesday in November 2013 after impressing with the club's youth teams. He made his Owls debut in Wednesday's 4–1 League Cup win over Mansfield Town at Hillsborough on 11 August 2015.

Joshua Charles Scowen (born 28 March 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Scowen came through Wycombe Wanderers's youth system, making his professional debut on 26 March 2011. On 1 July 2017, Scowen joined Championship club, Queens Park Rangers, following his release from Barnsley.
Armando Junior Quitirna (born 25 April 2000) is a Bissau-Guinean professional footballer who plays as a wing-back or attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers.

Luke Leahy (born 19 November 1992) is an English footballer, who plays as a defender or midfielder for Wycombe Wanderers. He started his career at Rugby Town and signed for Falkirk in 2012, where he played for five seasons. Leahy began his career with Rugby Town, affiliated with the Gordon Strachan Football Foundation.
Matthew Ryan Macey (born 9 September 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers.
Mikki Avelon Leander van Sas (born 29 February 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers as a goalkeeper.

Samuel David Parker (born 7 July 2006) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a right-back or right winger for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers, on loan from EFL Championship side Swansea City. He is a Wales Under-21 International.
English winger Silko Thomas plays as a forward or left winger for Wycombe Wanderers in EFL League One.
Steve Anthony Cook (born 19 April 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for League One club Wycombe Wanderers.

Stuart John Moore (born 8 September 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Wycombe Wanderers . In September 2011, Moore signed for Reading on a three-year scholarship, with a one-year professional contract. In August 2014, Moore and fellow Reading keeper, Jonathan Henly, joined Basingstoke Town on loan.
Tom Hounsell (born 9 February 1990) is an English professional football manager who is the head coach of EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers.
